scope: Observed clean-source D6 verification costs. Debug miss and release hit are different build contexts, not a controlled end-to-end A/B experiment. No broad-suite speedup or acceptance claim.

release_build.profile_caveat: Cargo timing rows do not identify the profile of duplicate crate units. Do not assign a duration to a build-script or normal profile without separate artifact evidence.

interpretation: The shared runtime image is reused across these debug/release contexts. Current release elapsed time is dominated by Rust compiler units, including duplicated heavy crates. Profile alignment or a crate split requires a separately measured implementation; neither is claimed here.

runtime_wasm_structure.interpretation: Raw Wasm contains16.0MB code,2.0MB data and22.4MB custom sections. Body sizes identify candidates for compiler profiling, not their individual compile time. Cross-profile code equality and savings from outlining remain unmeasured.
